services.name: Provincetown Evening Cruise - Beth Ann
services.desc: After the hustle and bustle from a day at the beach, and before your evening dinner reservation, come aboard the Beth Ann for a two hour relaxing excursion through Provincetown harbor, and around the historic and iconic lighthouses at Long Pt., Wood End and Race Pt. Bask in the comfort only Beth Ann can offer, as you experience the brilliant reflection of the suns early evening glow on the water. Bring your beverages of choice, and some snacks, or if you desire we can arrange to have a bottle or two of fine wine or champagne and some fabulous appetizers delivered for you. Private From $475 2 Hours • Up to 6 People

services.name: Fun in the Sun - Beth Ann
services.desc: Normally our customers want to go to the beach of their choice, where we anchor the boat relatively close to shore. Some like privacy, which inner Provincetown Harbor, Long Pt., Hatches Harbor and the great stretches of the ocean beaches past Race Point offer. Others like a little more action, such as between Herring Cove and Wood End, where bathing suits at times become optional and more of a party atmosphere prevails. Wherever we go, the Beth Ann becomes your home base. Wade or swim into shore and set up on the beach. Dive into the water to cool yourself off and relax on the boat. quotes.author: Rebekah Bressler
quotes.text: This was an awesome experience! We wanted to book a whale watch but didn't want to book one with a bunch of people. We ended up finding the kids charter and thought it would be perfect. It was a private charter and we wouldn't have to worry about a bunch of people. It was an amazing experience. Will definitely go back. Reese was a great mate and my daughter absolutely loved him. I was nervous about being a 5 year old on a boat but the captain and mate made us feel safe and comfortable the whole time. I can't wait to go back and try some of the other private charters!

quotes.author: Patricia Curnan
quotes.text: We had a great experience with Beth Ann Charters out of Provincetown. The captain let us know sightings had been sparse lately, but we ended us seeing 6 whales, several feeding and a full breach! -amazing! The boat was comfortable and the captain made the trip enjoyable, informative and personal. A good choice if you're looking for a private, relaxed whale watching experience.
